Demonstration Alert: “Mega March for Water” in Guadalajara on October 18 at 11:00 a.m.

Location: Avenida Juarez, Guadalajara, Mexico

Event:  A “Mega March for Water” demonstration is scheduled for Sunday, October 18 beginning at 11:00 a.m. Protesters plan to march from Parque Rojo (Parque Revolución) to the Government Palace (Palacio de Gobierno) in downtown Guadalajara.

Expect a large local police presence and traffic disruptions along Avenida Juarez. Traffic may be affected across the city.

Actions to Take:

  • Demonstrations can be unpredictable; avoid areas around protests and demonstrations.
  • Monitor local media for updates.
  • Follow the directions of local authorities and in case of emergency, call 911.
  • Sign up for the Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (STEP).

item.dc:creator: U.S. Mission to Mexico

item.content:encoded:
Weather Alert: Hurricane Trudy, U.S. Embassy Mexico City, U.S. Consulate General Guadalajara on Thursday, October 15, 2026

Locations:

  • Pacific Coast of Mexico, States of Guerrero, Michoacan, Colima, and Jalisco

Event: Hurricane Trudy is expected to be a major hurricane as it approaches the coast of Mexico this weekend. A Hurricane Watch and Tropical Storm Warning have already been issued.

Heavy rainfall is expected between Guerrero and Jalisco through the weekend. This rainfall may produce life-threatening flooding and mudslides, especially in areas of steep terrain.

Starting Friday, hazardous ocean conditions—intensified by storms—may result in deadly rip currents and rogue waves. Avoid entering the water or walking on beaches during dangerous conditions, heed warnings from local authorities, and monitor official weather updates closely.

Actions to Take:

  • Monitor local media for updates, follow directions from local officials, and in case of emergency, call 911.
  • Flights could be impacted. Check with your airline for updates.
  • Roads could be impacted due to flooding and mudslides, especially in areas of steep terrain. Check road conditions prior to traveling.
  • Monitor the National Hurricane Center and the Mexican National Meteorological Service on storm activity and emergency response.
  • Be prepared to seek shelter.
  • Have evacuation plans that do not rely on U.S. Government assistance.

Demonstration Alert: Demonstrations in Mexico City on October 13 at 15:00

Location: Paseo de la Reforma, Mexico City, Mexico

Event: Protestors plan to gather at the Siglo XXI National Medical Center and march to IMSS headquarters on Paseo de la Reforma on Monday, October 13 beginning at approximately 15:00.

Expect a large local police presence and traffic disruptions along on Av. Cuauhtémoc, Paseo de la Reforma, Av. Insurgentes, Circuito Interior, Viaducto Río de la Piedad, Eje 3 Oriente, Calzada de Tlalpan, and Eje 1 Norte. Traffic may be affected across the city.

Actions to Take:

  • Demonstrations can be unpredictable; avoid areas around protests and demonstrations.
  • Monitor local media for updates.
  • Follow the directions of local authorities and in case of emergency, call 911.
  • Sign up for the Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (STEP).
